hypothesis: A cohort-level losing streak threshold exists that pauses the alpha during genuine regime breaks without reacting to ordinary variance.
note: Config default 3 is the midpoint placeholder, not a selected value.

hypothesis: A fixed calendar cooldown is enough to skip the adverse regime; no data-dependent early exit is needed.
selection_metric: opportunity cost of the pause vs drawdown avoided

hypothesis: Re-entering at reduced size after a cooldown improves risk-adjusted recovery versus resuming at full size.
selection_metric: validation MAR over the recovery window

hypothesis: A small number of probation cohorts is sufficient evidence to restore full risk.
Excluding account-risk exits from the health trigger avoids false alpha-death without hiding real decay.
selection_metric: false-positive disable rate on the 2021-09 episode

hypothesis: A hybrid max(Donchian, entry - k*ATR) stop dominates either leg alone after costs.
selection_metric: cohort-level expectancy in R after costs

hypothesis: A stop distance plateau exists rather than a single sharp optimum.
selection_metric: plateau width of expectancy across neighbours

hypothesis: A Chandelier trail captures more of the trend tail than the Donchian exit alone.
selection_metric: MFE capture ratio and cohort R distribution

hypothesis: Moving to breakeven after k R improves risk-adjusted return net of the extra stop-outs it causes.
selection_metric: expectancy change after subtracting round-trip cost

hypothesis: A pre-registered risk-distance band removes degenerate signals without discarding valid ones.
A small tolerance absorbs the cost/slippage wedge without letting gap risk through.
selection_metric: resize frequency vs realized over-budget risk

hypothesis: The 20/10 pair sits on a parameter plateau rather than being a single lucky point.
selection_metric: share of neighbours passing the same gates
note: The current 20/10 has no independent stability evidence (STR-P2-08).

hypothesis: OBV confirmation adds positive marginal value after costs in the majority of OOS windows.
selection_metric: E2 - E1 marginal contribution per ablation window
